profile.name: Muhammed Shafeek
profile.title: Python Developer
profile.bio: Senior software engineer at Q1 technologies India pvt ltd.

experience.description: Working on multiple projects involving Python, Django, and full-stack development, with a focus on creating scalable solutions. Implemented backend services and integrated with cloud provider (AWS). Leading teams and mentoring junior developers, fostering skill development and improving team collaboration.

Led the development of web-based applications and services using Python, Django and AWS. Designed scalable software components and ensured optimal performance. Collaborated with cross-functional teams (product managers, UX/UI, and QA) to deliver key features. Managed the product lifecycle from definition and design to implementation and deployment.

projects.title: Microservices ETL Pipeline
projects.description: Built a scalable ETL pipeline using Python, Django, and Celery to process large volumes of data from multiple sources. Integrated with AWS S3 for storage, Redis for caching, and PostgreSQL for data warehousing. Containerized with Docker and deployed on AWS EC2 with CI/CD using GitHub Actions.
projects.technologies: Python, Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions

projects.title: Django REST API Platform
projects.description: Developed a RESTful API platform using Django REST Framework with JWT authentication, role-based access control, and API documentation. Integrated with PostgreSQL database and deployed on AWS with Nginx and Gunicorn. Implemented monitoring and logging for production observability.
projects.technologies: Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, AWS, Nginx, Gunicorn, JWT

projects.title: Data Processing & Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Created a data processing application using Python and Pandas to analyze and visualize business metrics. Built async task processing with Celery and Redis, containerized with Docker, and deployed to AWS. Includes automated reporting and data export features.
projects.technologies: Python, Pandas, Celery, Redis, Docker, AWS, HTML5, Bootstrap
